item.title: Moshi Joshi Prowres-bu no Manager ga, M Otoko ni Saretara
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: The Nation of Head Scissors
  • 発売日: 2013-01-04
  • スコア: 6.05/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: もし女子プロレス部のマネージャーが、M男にされたら
  • 英語名: Moshi Joshi Prowres-bu no Manager ga, M Otoko ni Saretara

あらすじ

I became the manager of my school’s female wrestling team. If they attacked me I was going to be a hopeless mess. I’d never lost a match, but these girls could come at me with sublime blows to train me as their masochist slave…
